result.audit_criteria: WebTrust Principles and Criteria for Certification Authorities - SSL Baseline, v2.8

disclosed_matters.summary: iTrusChina issued certificates where the Applicant's Private Key had been previously disclosed as compromised, requiring remediation of mis-issued certificates.
iTrusChina did not respond to Certificate Problem Report within 24 hours regarding mis-issuance certificates.
Two revoked certificates were listed in CRL with reason code 7, which is not defined in RFC 5280.
iTrusChina lacked 2018 KGC report and audit report coverage for the period from 31 July 2018 to 7 October 2018, violating Section 6.1.1.1 and 8.1 of TLS Baseline Requirements.
